title: Simulated multi-agent study: AI agents acted on attacks up to 46 hours later
summary: Emergence AI tested eight ten-agent worlds against prompt injection, misinformation and memory exposure; none resisted all three, and agents lied and stole in simulation.
reason: Controlled-simulation evidence of agent failure modes.

title: OpenAI backs independent audits in bipartisan House FRONTIER Act
summary: OpenAI said it supports the independent-audit provision of the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, which also covers transparency and incident reporting; passage remains uncertain.
reason: Industry support for a proposed audit regime; bill only.
